faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Clear answers to the most common questions from restaurant and cafe owners
faqs.q1: Do customers need to download an app to open the menu?
faqs.a1: Not at all! Customers simply scan the QR code with their phone camera and the interactive menu opens instantly in the browser.
faqs.a2: Orders can be received directly on WhatsApp with full customization details, or tracked through the live cashier and KDS screen.
faqs.q3: Can I update prices and items myself?
faqs.a3: Yes, easily! Through a simple dashboard from your phone or computer, you can update prices, add new items, or hide sold-out dishes in seconds.
faqs.q4: Do you charge any commission on sales or orders?
faqs.a4: No, MenuJet charges 0% commission on your orders. You keep 100% of your earnings with zero hidden fees.
